en: Black‑and‑white interior view of a modernist Roman Catholic church, photographed from the back toward the altar. The nave is long, with plain curved walls and a barrel‑vault or domed ceiling punctuated by small round-arched windows high up. Tall, simple pointed-arch openings line both sides, above side aisles with statues in niches and minimal ornamentation. Wooden pews fill the nave in orderly rows. At the far end stands a raised chancel with multiple steps, a large crucifix on the back wall, a draped cloth, and side altars and candlesticks. The style mixes early‑20th‑century modernist simplicity with traditional liturgical layout.
